name: Send daily Splunk license usage to Teams
description: Posts Splunk license ingestion vs the 10 GB daily threshold to a Teams group chat at 9 AM ET on weekdays (Mondays cover Fri-Sun). Built locally for import into the company n8n (2.44.5); any failure, incl. an empty Splunk result, alerts the owner's DM.

nodes.name: Run license usage search

parameters.search:
=search index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage earliest={{ $now.weekday === 1 ? "-3d@d" : "-1d@d" }} latest=@d
| eval report_date=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d")
| stats sum(b) as total_bytes count as usage_events by report_date
| eval ingestion_gb=round(total_bytes/1024/1024/1024,2)
| table report_date ingestion_gb usage_events

nodes.notes: Mondays search Friday to Sunday (earliest=-3d@d), other days search yesterday (earliest=-1d@d). Exec Mode "Blocking" makes Splunk reply only after the search has finished.

nodes.name: Build usage message

assignments.name: teamsPayload

nodes.notes: Kept as its own step so test runs (which never execute the Teams post) can check the exact message, and so every run log shows what was sent.

nodes.name: Post usage to group chat

parameters.url: <__PLACEHOLDER_VALUE__Group chat webhook URL from Teams, without the &sig=... part__>

nodes.notes: Setup: URL = the group chat webhook URL from Teams Workflows with its "&sig=..." part removed. The sig value goes in the Query Auth credential (Name: sig, Value: the sig value).

parameters.errorMessage: =Splunk returned no license usage rows. Check that the user behind the Splunk API token can search index=_internal. Splunk messages: {{ ($("Get search results").item.json.messages ?? []).map(m => m.type + ": " + m.text).join("; ") || "none" }}

nodes.name: Build error message

assignments.name: teamsPayload

nodes.notes: Kept as its own step so test runs (which never execute the Teams post) can check the exact message, and so every run log shows what was sent.

nodes.name: Send error to my DM

parameters.url: <__PLACEHOLDER_VALUE__DM webhook URL from Teams, without the &sig=... part__>

nodes.notes: Setup: URL = the DM webhook URL from Teams Workflows with its "&sig=..." part removed. The sig value goes in the Query Auth credential (Name: sig, Value: the sig value).

nodeGroups.name: Query Splunk
nodeGroups.description: Runs the license usage search and waits for it: Friday to Sunday on Mondays, yesterday otherwise. One row per day.

nodeGroups.name: Check rows and post
nodeGroups.description: Posts one block per day to the Teams group chat. No rows stops the run with an error, which alerts the DM.

nodeGroups.name: Alert my DM
nodeGroups.description: Runs when any step above fails: posts the failed step, the error and a link to the run to the Teams DM.
